channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump says he wants "permanent" deal with Iran
item.description: Despite rising tension, President Trump told an Israeli outlet he may not make a decision on his next move in the Iran war until 2027.

item.title: Violence breaks out in Mexico after capture of drug kingpin wanted by FBI
item.description: Fausto Isidro Meza-Flores is allegedly the leader of a cartel responsible for drug distribution and importation.

item.title: Taiwan warns Canada faces the China risks Carney has cautioned against
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has tried to deepen trade ties with China.

item.title: What's behind the uptick in attacks in the Strait of Hormuz?
item.description: Reported Strait of Hormuz attacks have been higher in number in October and November than other months since the war between the U.S., Israel and Iran...
